nativeBaseline.reference: non-interactive color sample with textual or accessible-name equivalent when meaningful

library: provide a visible swatch boundary including forced-colors presentation
consumer: do not use color as the sole carrier of meaning
pair meaningful colors with visible text or an accessible name appropriate to the surrounding semantics

notes: A role and accessible name are needed only when the swatch itself must act as the named semantic object; adjacent visible text may carry the meaning instead.
